newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Electronics slide hits Taiwan GDRs.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Electronics slide hits Taiwan GDRs.

text.p: Taiwanese global depositary receipts came under further pressure on Tuesday, after electronics stocks slid in Taipei earlier, traders said.
But they said they were hopeful of a rebound on the local market following recent volatility.
A call by regulators in Taiwan on Tuesday for closer scrutiny of the electronics sector's performance sparked local market declines.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index shed 3.79 points, or 2.81 percent to 131.05, representing a discount to the local market of 2.90 percent from 3.15 percent.
Taiwan's weighted index shed 2.88 percent on Tuesday.
Indian GDRs picked up following light declines on Monday, but traders said volumes remained low and the market lacked clear direction. The local market rose for the second straight day on Tuesday.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.42 points firmer at 83.47, a 0.50 percent rise, with the premium over the local market at 17.91 percent from 18.11 percent.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index added 0.24 points to 93.47 -- a 17.59 percent premium to the local market. It measures from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
Bombay's benchmark index added 32.01 points to 4,186.29.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index shed 1.16 points to 73.62 points, a premium of 41.11 percent over the local market.
